response.overview: A deeply emotional social drama and allegory centered around the ultimate tragedy of selflessness. The story revolves around the pure and innocent friendship between a horse and a goat. When the horse falls critically ill, the goat selflessly nurses him back to health, saving his life. However, in a cruel and heartbreaking twist of irony, the homeowner decides to celebrate the horse’s miraculous recovery by throwing a grand feast—and he does so by slaughtering the very same goat to make mutton biryani. Even as his wife weeps bitterly and begs him to spare the animal's life, he refuses to listen.Through this devastating bond, the film mirrors a painful, universal truth that has repeated itself throughout human history: those who bring welfare, healing, and goodness to society are ultimately sacrificed and made the scapegoats by their own.
response.tagline: "The ultimate price of saving a life... is becoming the sacrifice."
response.title: O Sathi Re . . . !
